storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Circle Downloader makes it easy to save videos from Circle.so communities, Tella recordings, Loom videos, and embedded content from YouTube, Vimeo, and Wistia.

How it works: Navigate to any Circle.so community page, Tella recording, or Loom video and press play. Click the extension icon to detect the video, select your quality, and download. The extension automatically identifies the video source across 7+ platforms and converts streams to standard MP4 files.

It handles HLS streaming, DASH manifests, Shadow DOM traversal, and multi-platform embedded players automatically -- no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized Circle Downloader subfolder.

Key features:
- Multi-platform video detection: Circle.so, Tella.tv, Loom.com, YouTube.com, Vimeo.com, Wistia.com
- Shadow DOM traversal for Circle.so embedded players
- Converts HLS and DASH streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Up to 3 concurrent downloads with real-time progress
- YouTube URL display with yt-dlp copy commands (Mac and Windows)
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to a Circle.so community, Tella recording, or Loom video and press play
3. Click the extension icon
4. Select quality and download -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: What sites does this extension support?
faq.answer: Circle.so (and Circle.com), Tella.tv, Loom.com, YouTube.com, Vimeo.com, and Wistia.com. It also detects generic embedded video players on other sites.

faq.question: How do I download a video from Circle.so?
faq.answer: Go to any Circle.so community page with a video, press play, then click the extension icon. The extension traverses Circle's Shadow DOM to detect the embedded player, extracts available qualities, and lets you download as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download Loom videos before they auto-delete?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to the Loom video URL, press play, and use the extension to save it as MP4 before it expires or gets deleted.

faq.question: What about Tella recordings?
faq.answer: Tella recordings are fully supported. Open the Tella.tv recording link, let the video load, and download with the extension.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: Quality depends on the source platform. The extension detects all available resolutions and lists them in the quality selector, sorted highest to lowest.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a Circle Downloader subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Can I download multiple videos at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension supports up to 3 concurrent downloads with individual progress tracking.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the stream to start before detection works. On Circle.so, make sure the lesson or post page is fully loaded. If issues persist, refresh the page.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored. No video data is sent to external servers.
